# `.github/agents/rag_system/_archive/`

Historical RAG-system materials and project-specific artifacts that are
not part of the live RAG package surface:

- Milestone reports and "new features" summaries that the parent
  README warns against treating as canonical operating docs.
- `750_Picacho_*` — output artifacts from a one-off engagement, not
  reusable infrastructure.
- `batch_process_750_picacho_enhanced.py`, `compare_outputs.py` —
  engagement-specific scripts that hard-code the 750 Picacho dataset.

For current RAG usage and architecture, see `../README.md` and the
modules exported by `../__init__.py`.
